title: Consensus times for monotone aggregation dynamics
summary: We study an asynchronous consensus dynamics on $N$ agents: at each step a uniformly chosen agent replaces its state by $f(Y_1,\dots,Y_r)$, where $f$ is a fixed monotone aggregation rule and $Y_1,\dots,Y_r$ are the states of $r$ agents sampled uniformly with replacement. Let $T$ be the first time at which all agents agree. Let $f:\{0,1\}^r\to\{0,1\}$ be monotone and non-constant.
